chunks: Al-Saffar narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Musa, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Ja'far, from his father, peace be upon them both, that 'Ali, peace be upon him, said:
Wait regarding the minors whose father was killed until they grow up. Then, when they reach maturity, they are given the choice: if they wish, they may kill, or pardon, or make a settlement.

key_terms.اِنْتَظِرُوا: Delay action and wait before carrying out judgment
key_terms.بِالصِّغَارِ: Concerning the minors who have not yet reached maturity
key_terms.خُيِّرُوا: Were given the legal choice between available options
key_terms.صَالَحُوا: They agreed to a settlement or compensation
key_terms.قُتِلَ: Was killed unlawfully, giving rise to a retaliatory claim

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for minor heirs in a murder case when their father has been killed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning minors whose father has been killed and who hold a right in retaliation. Their claim is not acted upon during childhood; rather, they are waited for until maturity. Once they reach adulthood, they may choose between retaliation, pardon, or settlement.
